errors.text_span: Die horizontale Achse zeigt verschiedene Unterstützungsmaßnahmen
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis shows the numerical values (from 0 to 1.40). The vertical axis shows the categories ('Unterstützungsmaßnahmen'). The description incorrectly swaps the axes.
The category label in the chart is 'Zugang zu Wagniskapital' (venture capital), not 'Zugang zu Wachstumskapital' (growth capital).

errors.text_span: Die vertikale Achse stellt die Werte auf einer linearen Skala von 0 bis 1,4 dar
errors.evidence: The vertical axis lists the categories. It is the horizontal axis that represents the numerical values on a scale from 0 to 1.4. The description incorrectly swaps the axes.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind in absteigender Reihenfolge ihrer Werte angeordnet
errors.evidence: The bars are not sorted in any order. For example, the value for 'Vernetzungsmöglichkeiten' (0.72) is higher than for 'Mentoringprogramme' (0.70) which is above it, but the next bar, 'Start-up-Grundsicherung' (1.22), has a much higher value.
The category label in the chart is 'Zugang zu Wagniskapital' (venture capital), not 'Zugang zu Wachstumskapital' (growth capital). The error is repeated.
